recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: hexagonal keys mapping every musical interval to a single shape
on-call bots closing tickets while humans forget the wiring underneath
clear september night at twelve degrees over the bay
early autumn settling in before a mostly clear dawn
agents spun up from a phone while the city still sleeps

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Play a Terpstra-style hex keyboard — tap glowing interval cells as microtonal pitch shards drift off-grid before the tuning lattice collapses.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm tap on hex keys matching incoming pitch shards
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap hex cells in sequence as they pulse
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: completing one perfect octave ring unlocks a harmonic bloom that washes the whole grid
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: grid rotates, intervals shrink, and phantom notes appear in wrong cells
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: isomorphic neon honeycomb on matte black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Trace live signal wires between blinking server nodes before an autopilot AI prunes your branches — keep one human-readable path alive through the stack.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw a path connecting nodes while AI severs competing routes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag finger to lay cable, release to commit the route
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each preserved connection lights up a forgotten dashboard metric for one satisfying beat
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: AI cuts lines mid-draw, nodes migrate, and duplicate decoys appear
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: schematic PCB traces with amber pulse on slate gray

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Hold warmth in shrinking clear-night pockets over the bay — release when fog rolls in to ship your build before the cold drops to twelve degrees.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: hold/release timing to capture thermal pockets
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: hold to charge a warmth bubble, release when the fog edge aligns
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: three perfect releases stack a shipping-by-sunrise bar that crests at dawn
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind shears pockets smaller and fog arrives from two directions at once
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor bay silhouette with cold blue gradients warming to peach at horizon

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick autumn leaves into chromatic stacks — sort drifting red-gold shards into ascending gradient bins before the wind scrambles the pile.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: physics flick sorting into color lanes
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick leaves at angle into left, center, or right gradient bins
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: a perfect gradient run paints the whole screen one seamless autumn sweep
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: gusts spin leaves mid-air, bins shrink, and duplicate hues demand split-second lane changes
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper-cutout leaf silhouettes with ink-wash shadows
